annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National AI Office (NAIO), Ministry of Digital, Malaysia
annotation.summary_en: Malaysia's National AI Office consultation page on a proposed AI Governance Bill, with a Central AI Authority, Sectoral Leads, five principles, a three-tier risk framework, incident reporting and an AI Sandbox. The page mainly reproduces about 66 stakeholder comments, which criticise narrow harm categories, intent-based Tier 1, missing liability allocation and environmental gaps.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a Central AI Authority with Sectoral Leads for oversight
Five principle-based baseline requirements, including human dignity and transparency
Three-tier risk framework with harm categories limited to death, bodily injury, deprivation of liberty and breach of law
Developer/Deployer duties allocated by degree of control
AI incident reporting mechanism and supervised AI Sandbox
